title: OmniMetrix Cellular Generator Monitors
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > AMC > ACC > MISSION & INSTALLATION CONTRACTING COMMAND > 418TH CSB > W6QM MICC-FT JACKSON
description:
This amendment updates the solicitation number on all documents and revises the PWS start date to align with the solicitation start date. 

 Responses to vendor questions are available in the Vendor Questions and Answers document under Attachments/Links.  

 All other terms and conditions, including the quotation due date, remain unchanged. 

 This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial services prepared in accordance with part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. 

 Solicitation number W9124C27QA005 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for OmniMetrix Cellular Generator Monitors. The Contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, and other items and non-personal services necessary to perform Generator Monitoring as defined in this Performance Work Statement, except for those items specified as government furnished property and services. The Contractor shall perform to the standards in this contract. 

 This acquisition is set-aside for 100% Total Small Business. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. 

 Please refer to the attached documents for the remainder of the solicitation. 

 Response time: Questions are due no later than 10:00AM on 9 November 2026. Quotes are due no later than 10:00AM on 20 November 2026.
